<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.

Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

## Modifications

Pin triton to v3.9.0 (b7ddcf86)

## Accuracy Tests


Triton 3.8 is `3.8.0+git1001b1bc` (triton-lang/triton@76940ad3 plus the revert of triton-lang/triton#10833); Triton 3.9 is v3.9.0 (`b7ddcf86`) without the revert.

| Model | Config | Accuracy (3.8 → 3.9) | Performance (3.8 → 3.9) | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V4-Flash | TP8 | GSM8K 0.947 → 0.946 | 914 / 912 → 920 tok/s | Match |
| FLUX.2-dev (with negative prompt) | TP2 CFG parallel, torch.compile | Image PSNR 30.2 dB (3.8 run-to-run: 30.8 dB) | 32.78 → 32.62 s | Match |
| FLUX.2-dev (no negative prompt) | TP2 CFG parallel, torch.compile | Image PSNR 44.1 dB (3.8 run-to-run: 40.0 dB) | 32.02 → 32.14 s | Match |
| gpt-oss-120b W4A8 | TP2, W4A8 backend=triton | GSM8K 0.836 → 0.836, 0.835 → 0.835 | 3558 → 3580 tok/s | Match |
| Wan2.2-T2V-A14B | TP1, 720p, 193 frames, 8 steps | Video PSNR 39.1 dB | 1523 → 1530 s | Match |
| Wan2.2-T2V-A14B | TP2 CFG parallel | Video PSNR 28.3 dB | 977 → 1002 s | Match |

Notes:
- PSNR compares the 3.9 output against the 3.8 output. For FLUX.2, "3.8 run-to-run" is the PSNR between two 3.8 runs, a baseline for same-version nondeterminism.
- DeepSeek-V4-Flash: GSM8K via `run_eval` (5-shot). Benchmark at concurrency 64, 320 prompts, 8K input / 1K output (3.8: 2 runs, 3.9: 1 run).
- gpt-oss-120b:
  - Run with `--disable-custom-all-reduce`, because custom all-reduce crashes during CUDA graph capture on both 3.8 and 3.9.
  - GSM8K is 5-shot completion on all 1319 questions, 2 rounds per version.
  - Throughput is with a warm cache. The cold first round was 1636 → 1520 tok/s, from slightly slower compilation on 3.9.
  - The default gluon W4A8 backend was not tested end to end. aiter's unit tests show 8 failures only on 3.9 in `out_mx_quant` mode.
- Wan2.2:
  - All three environments (3.8, 3.9, and the ROCm 10.0 image `v0.5.23-rocm10-mi45x-20261102`) show the same broken frames: noise in the first ~40 frames and no content in the last ~40. This is not caused by Triton.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -346,9 +346,7 @@ RUN mkdir -p /etc/sglang/constraints && : > /etc/sglang/constraints/torch-rocm.t
 # flavor name, so they apply here unchanged.
 FROM $BASE_IMAGE_1250_ROCM1000 AS gfx1250-rocm1000
 ENV BUILD_VLLM="0"
-# Unlike the gfx942/gfx950 images, this one replaces the SDK's Triton: the
-# revision below is what the MI45x bring-up ran on, and it carries a fix the
-# SDK build does not have yet.
+# Unlike the gfx942/gfx950 images, this one replaces the SDK's Triton.
 ENV BUILD_TRITON="1"
 ENV BUILD_LLVM="0"
 ENV BUILD_AITER_ALL="1"
@@ -357,25 +355,19 @@ ENV BUILD_MOONCAKE="1"
 # shared pin. Validated by the manual gfx1250 AITER Scout #173 A/B (no automated
 # gfx1250 Scout): gpt-oss, Flux.2, Wan2.2 and Kimi-K2 all NO_NEW_REGRESSION.
 ENV AITER_COMMIT_DEFAULT="26f4f1fb2de14d122c71f5fed7afb97a5c97cade"
-# The upstream Triton the gfx1250 bring-up was validated against, carried over
-# from the ROCm 7.14 flavor this image replaced. Built from source below.
-ENV TRITON_COMMIT_DEFAULT="76940ad348795521b3dc9f6c79acd7309ff924e3"
+# Triton v3.9.0, built from source below.
+ENV TRITON_COMMIT_DEFAULT="b7ddcf86c095de79527ba3098503e73158bb94bd"
 ENV PIP_CONSTRAINT="/etc/sglang/constraints/torch-rocm.txt"
 RUN mkdir -p /etc/sglang/constraints && : > /etc/sglang/constraints/torch-rocm.txt
 
 # ===============================
 # Base image 1250 with ROCm 10.1.0 and args (Python 3.12 + torch 2.12)
 FROM $BASE_IMAGE_1250_ROCM1010 AS gfx1250-rocm1010
 ENV BUILD_VLLM="0"
-# Keep the Triton that comes with the SDK. The rocm1000 flavor builds a newer
-# Triton from source, and that one no longer has block pointers or
-# triton_kernels (triton-lang/triton#10833), which sglang still uses.
 ENV BUILD_TRITON="1"
-ENV TRITON_COMMIT_DEFAULT="76940ad348795521b3dc9f6c79acd7309ff924e3"
-# triton-lang/triton#10833 removed block pointers, which sglang's FLA kernels
-# (fla/, used by Qwen3-Next, MiniMax and Kimi Linear) still call. The revert is
-# pure Python: #9668 had already moved block pointers out of C++/MLIR.
-ENV TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS_DEFAULT="9debefe44117a44c274b05033cfe9e4858883b86"
+# Triton v3.9.0. No revert of triton-lang/triton#10833 needed: sglang#45470
+# restores block pointers for the FLA kernels.
+ENV TRITON_COMMIT_DEFAULT="b7ddcf86c095de79527ba3098503e73158bb94bd"
 ENV BUILD_LLVM="0"
 ENV BUILD_AITER_ALL="1"
 ENV BUILD_MOONCAKE="1"
